definitions.explanation: a type of Japanese omelet made by rolling thin layers of egg mixed with dashi broth; softer and more moist than tamagoyaki

examples.japanese: {出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧。
⟦{京都|きょうと}→京都：09484_kyouto⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{有名|ゆうめい}→有名：01106_yuumei⟧だ。
{出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦ふわふわ→ふわふわ：05156_fuwafuwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧おいしい。
examples.english: The dashimaki tamago is fluffy and delicious.

notes:
SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧: the general word for a rolled omelet. Home and bento versions are often sweetened with sugar and firmer. {出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご} adds a generous amount of dashi, which makes it soft and juicy; it is associated with Kansai and with izakaya and Japanese-restaurant menus.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {出汁巻|だしま}き{卵|たまご}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{焼|や}く→焼く：01123_yaku⟧: to make dashimaki (literally "grill")
- ⟦{卵焼|たまごや}き→卵焼き：10367_tamagoyaki⟧{器|き}: the rectangular pan used to roll it
- ⟦{大根|だいこん}おろし→大根おろし：26890_daikonoroshi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{添|そ}える: to serve it with grated daikon

WRITING:
Also written だし{巻|ま}き⟦{卵|たまご}→卵：02222_tamago⟧ or だし{巻|ま}き{玉子|たまご}, and often shortened to だし{巻|ま}き.
